draft.emotion: warm and friendly, introducing someone new
notes: Has a special declension: the stem changes to имен- in singular cases (имени, именем) and in the plural (имена, имён).
Used for people and animals. For the name of an object, book, or place, use 'название'.
Usually means a person's given (first) name, as opposed to 'фамилия' (surname) and 'отчество' (patronymic).
